load_profile.arrival_pattern: All 50 virtual users started each 5-second interval together (synchronized burst).

limitations: Single local Windows host with loopback HTTP; no TLS, WAN/network latency, deployment reverse proxy, multi-instance scaling, or third-party services were included.
The bundled server implementation is single-process and single-threaded, matching the repository's local serve.py configuration.
All load data and accounts are synthetic; the test does not establish production capacity or availability.

artifacts.database: Temporary synthetic SQLite database; not included

finding: The measured p95 met its threshold, but the failure-rate gate failed: 647 samples ended in connection resets during synchronized 50-user bursts. The server uses the repository local single-threaded WSGI configuration; synchronized arrivals may have exceeded its pending-connection queue. Investigate before claiming 50-user load acceptance.
